companion.pageSubtitle: For the safety of our inpatients and their relatives at our hospitals
companion.policyDesc: As Anadolu Hospitals, without disrupting the service flow, within the means of our hospital and to the extent required by the patient's health condition, within the appropriate time and method, by setting certain rules, by ensuring the support and participation of the patient's relatives to meet the medical care and psychosocial needs of our inpatients, we aim to increase our corporate image and provide quality health service.
companion.whoNotTitle: Who Should Not Be a Companion?
companion.whoNot2: Those with complaints such as fever, cough, sputum,
companion.whoNot3: Those with an infectious disease or predisposition to infection,
companion.whoNot5: Those with any chronic disease should not be companions.
companion.ruleSmokingDesc: Smoking and tobacco products are not allowed inside the hospital building.
companion.ruleNoiseDesc: Do not speak loudly and make noise inside the hospital building.
companion.ruleHygieneDesc: Companions must absolutely comply with hand hygiene rules.
companion.ruleFoodDesc: Food/beverages should not be brought from outside and should not be given to the patient without consulting the doctor/nurse.
companion.ruleLimitDesc: The number of companions is limited to 1 (one) person except in special circumstances.
companion.ruleVisitDesc: Companions should leave patient rooms during doctor visit hours.
companion.mealNote: Only our registered companion can benefit from the meal service free of charge.
companion.detail1: Companions must not perform any procedure on the patient other than as directed by the doctor or nurse.
companion.detail2: Companions should help staff in following hospital rules.
companion.detail3: Companions are registered by presenting an ID during patient admission.
companion.detail4: The ward nurse must always be informed when the companion changes. The patient must not be taken outside without the request of the relevant doctor or nurse.
companion.detail5: During admission, the patient should hand over valuables to their companion.
companion.detail6: If there is any problem with the patient's health, the ward nurses should be informed first.
companion.detail7: Potted plants are not allowed in patient rooms due to the risk of infection.
companion.detail8: Male companions may not stay in women's wards.
companion.detail9: Companions must wear the companion ID card issued in their name at all times.
companion.detail10: Electrical appliances (tea or coffee makers) must not be used in the rooms.
companion.detail11: Do not bring small toys for child patients. Do not give back toys that have fallen on the floor without cleaning them.
companion.detail12: To prevent patient falls, make sure the bed rails are kept in the raised position.
companion.special1: In units with terminally ill, geriatric, immunosuppressed or abused patients, companions must use personal protective equipment (mask, cap, etc.).
companion.special2: People staying with these special patient groups must not have an infection or serious chronic disease and should be people the patient knows and trusts.
companion.special3: After surgery or discharge from intensive care, the instructions of the ward nurse must be followed strictly.

deptDetail.step1Desc: The patient's complaints are listened to, physical examination is performed and necessary tests are requested.

deptDetail.step3Desc: A multidisciplinary treatment strategy specific to the patient is determined.

deptDetail.processArticle: In our {{deptName}} unit, we follow a carefully designed treatment process to provide our patients with the highest quality healthcare. The process begins with a comprehensive evaluation from the patient's first visit. Thanks to our specialist physicians, modern diagnostic devices and laboratory infrastructure, an accurate diagnosis is made quickly. After diagnosis, a personalized treatment plan is created, taking into account the patient's age, general health and needs. Throughout the treatment, patients and their relatives are informed at every stage and actively involved in the process. When surgery is required, minimally invasive methods are preferred in our state-of-the-art operating rooms. After treatment, recovery is supported with regular follow-up appointments and rehabilitation programs. Throughout this entire process, patient satisfaction and safety are our highest priorities.

patientRights.right1Desc: Within the framework of Justice and Equity principles, you have the right to benefit from health services regardless of language, religion, race, gender and social status.
patientRights.right2Desc: You have the right to learn about all services and opportunities offered at our hospital and to receive any oral or written information about your health condition.
patientRights.right3Desc: You have the right to choose and change the health institution, to learn the identities and duties of the doctors and health workers who serve you, and to choose and change your doctor.
patientRights.right4Desc: You have the right to receive health services in an environment where privacy rules are respected and privacy is respected.
patientRights.right5Desc: You have the right to have your consent obtained for medical interventions, to refuse the applied treatment or to request its cessation.
patientRights.right6Title: Security and Respect for Human Values
patientRights.right6Desc: You have the right to receive treatment in a safe, clean, noise-free, smiling and kind environment and to fulfill your religious duties in accordance with your beliefs.
patientRights.pageSubtitle: Your health, your rights. We are here for your safe treatment process.
patientRights.rightsTitle: Your Rights Are Under Our Guarantee
patientRights.rightsDesc: Patient rights are the most basic part of the right to a healthy life. Being healthy and staying healthy are among the most fundamental inalienable rights of people from birth. As Anadolu Hospitals, we attach great importance to all the rights you have during your treatment process and shape our services with this awareness.
patientRights.responsibilitiesDesc: For your treatment to yield the best results, you should not forget that you are also a participating part of the treatment team. The quality of the service provided is directly proportional to your compliance.
patientRights.resp1: To act in accordance with the rules and practices of the health institution you apply to.
patientRights.resp2: To fully and accurately convey to your doctor the medications you use, previous treatments and your complaints.
patientRights.resp3: To come for check-ups at the times determined by the physician and to inform the institution in a timely manner about appointment cancellations.
patientRights.resp4: To respect the rights of other patients, visitors and hospital staff.
patientRights.footer: You can share your opinions, thanks or complaints about the service you received with our hospital's Patient Rights Unit or use the contact form on our website.

quality.standardsDesc: You can access the Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Health Quality Standards in Healthcare (SAS) document and related files via the link below. Our audit and assessment processes are carried out in line with these standards.
quality.linksDesc: You can access official documents regarding our quality management system and related platforms via the cards below.
quality.accreditationTitle: Directorate General of Quality in Healthcare, Accreditation and Employee Rights
quality.accreditationDesc: Ministry of Health Directorate General of Quality in Healthcare, Accreditation and Employee Rights assessment database platform.
quality.selfAssessmentDesc: Document regarding the quality self-assessment team work plan.
quality.unitDesc: The execution of our quality management system, internal audits and continuous improvement activities are coordinated by our quality management unit.
quality.managerBio: Our quality management unit is responsible for ensuring compliance with the Ministry of Health Quality Standards in Healthcare (SAS/SKS) and international accreditation standards, monitoring processes, conducting internal audits and coordinating quality improvement activities.
quality.councilSafetyDesc: It is the committee that evaluates all safety incidents in our hospital, takes precautions and determines policies.
quality.councilInfectionDesc: It is the committee that ensures the prevention and follow-up of hospital infections and conducts surveillance studies.
quality.councilEthicsDesc: It is the committee that protects patient rights and evaluates ethical issues in accordance with medical ethical principles.
quality.councilQualityDesc: It is the committee that plans and monitors continuous improvement activities within the framework of HQS (Healthcare Quality Standards).
quality.councilMedicalDesc: It is the supreme council that makes decisions to increase the efficiency of medical processes and patient satisfaction.
quality.councilRiskDesc: It is the committee that identifies, evaluates corporate risks and develops strategies to reduce them.
quality.employeeSafetyDesc: It is the committee that carries out risk assessments and takes precautions for our employees to work in a healthy and safe environment.
quality.patientSafetyDesc: It is the structure that coordinates basic patient safety processes such as patient identification, medication safety and prevention of falls.
quality.educationDesc: It is the committee that plans the professional development and in-service training activities of our staff, and carries out studies to raise awareness of quality and accreditation standards.
quality.managementOrgDesc: It is the structure that audit the administrative processes of our hospital, limits of authority and the quality of operation of the organizational structure.
quality.accreditationStandards: Accreditation Standards in Healthcare - Hospital Set
quality.accreditationStandardsDesc: It is the structure that carries out and supervises full compliance studies with the Ministry of Health SKS and international accreditation standards.
quality.facilityManagementDesc: It is the committee that inspects the safety of the hospital infrastructure, emergency systems and continuous operation of the technical equipment.
quality.infectionControlDesc: It is the committee that monitors infection risks throughout the hospital, determines hygiene protocols and conducts audits.
quality.radiationSafetyDesc: It is the board that inspects the protection of patients and employees from radiation in areas such as radiology and nuclear medicine.
quality.nutritionTeamDesc: It is the team that evaluates the nutritional status of inpatients and creates enteral and parenteral nutrition plans.
quality.organTransplantDesc: It is the committee that supervises organ and tissue transplant processes, donor and recipient coordination in accordance with ethical and legal rules.
quality.transfusionCommitteeDesc: It is the committee that supervises the safe use of blood and blood products, monitoring transfusion reactions and blood bank processes.
quality.medicationSafetyDesc: It is the team that prevents medication errors, monitors high-risk medications, and audits safe medication use protocols.
quality.employeeOpinionsDesc: It is the team that carries out activities to improve working conditions in line with employee satisfaction surveys and feedback.
quality.patientRightsSatisfaction: Patient Rights and Patient Satisfaction Evaluation Committee
quality.patientRightsSatisfactionDesc: It is the committee that examines violations of patient rights, analyzes patient satisfaction feedback, and plans corrective activities.
quality.ftrUnitEvaluationDesc: It is the team that audits the service quality, patient safety, and device suitability of the Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation unit.
quality.buildingTourDesc: It is the team that conducts regular physical inspections throughout the hospital to monitor facility safety, cleanliness, and environmental layout.
quality.disasterEmergencyDesc: It is the team that prepares the Hospital Disaster and Emergency Plan (HAP), organizes emergency drills, and provides coordination during crisis moments.

quality.step3Desc: Monitoring the compliance of processes with HQS and ISO standards through internal audit.
quality.step4Desc: Initiation of corrective activities and evaluation of results in line with findings.

visiting.pageSubtitle: Visit procedures at our hospitals and rules you need to follow
visiting.purposeTitle: What is the Purpose of Visiting?
visiting.purpose1: To meet the patient's needs that need to be provided from outside (clothing, etc.).
visiting.purpose2: To provide psychological support by asking about the patient's well-being.
visiting.purpose3: To contribute to the healing process by raising the patient's morale due to social solidarity.
visiting.normalHoursDesc: Visits are accepted every day at Anadolu Hospitals. Two different time periods have been determined as daytime and evening.
visiting.nightTitle: Why Shouldn't You Visit at Night?
visiting.nightDesc: The number of staff decreases at night. Night visits are prohibited because security, patient sleep and patient rights are negatively affected.
visiting.icuDesc: Visits in intensive care are made according to the patient's condition and the physician's decision. Usually, the visit duration is arranged not to exceed 5 minutes.
visiting.icuAdultDesc: Physician information every day between 13:00 - 14:00. Short visit after information on Monday, Wednesday, Friday.
visiting.icuKvcDesc: Visiting hours are after 17:00 on days deemed appropriate.
visiting.icuCoronerDesc: Visiting hours are between 09:00 - 10:00 on weekdays.
visiting.icuNewbornDesc: Information between 11:30 - 12:30 every day. Visit is held on days deemed appropriate by the physician.
visiting.whoNotVisit2: Those with complaints such as fever, cough, sneezing and sputum
visiting.whoNotVisit3: Patients with a known infectious disease
visiting.whoNotVisit5: People with weak immune systems (prone to infection)
visiting.rule1: The visit duration should be short (preferably no more than 10 minutes).
visiting.rule2: There should be no more than two visitors per patient and no loud speaking.
visiting.rule3: Do not bring food when visiting and do not give food to other patients in the same room.
visiting.rule4: Do not sit on patient beds.
visiting.rule5: Rooms should be left without waiting for the staff's warning at the end of visiting hours.

emergency.triage1Desc: Respiratory failure, cardiac arrest, shock, severe trauma. Treated immediately.
emergency.triage2Desc: Chest pain, serious bleeding, fractures, febrile seizures. Assessed within 10 minutes.
emergency.triage3Desc: Moderate abdominal pain, burns, dizziness. Assessed within 30 minutes.
emergency.triage4Desc: Minor wounds, sprains, fever, cough. Assessed within 60 minutes.
emergency.triage5Desc: Common cold, mild allergies, follow-up of chronic conditions. As soon as possible.
emergency.svcAmbulanceDesc: Hospital transfer and on-site intervention with our fully equipped ambulance fleet.
emergency.svcCardioDesc: Immediate intervention for heart attacks, arrhythmias and respiratory failure.
emergency.svcTraumaDesc: A multidisciplinary trauma team for traffic accidents, falls and occupational accidents.
emergency.svcPediatricDesc: A special approach and equipment for children with our pediatric emergency specialists.
emergency.svcSurgeryDesc: A 24/7 surgical team for appendicitis, acute abdomen, bleeding and similar conditions.
emergency.svcPoisonDesc: Detox and treatment for drug, food and chemical poisoning.
emergency.metaDescription: 24/7 uninterrupted emergency care. Immediate intervention in life-threatening situations with our specialist physicians and modern equipment.
emergency.heroDesc: Every second counts in life-threatening situations. We are by your side 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with our expert staff and modern equipment.
emergency.triageDesc: In our emergency department, patients are assessed with a 5-level triage system according to the severity of their complaints. This ensures priority for patients whose lives are at risk.
emergency.infoTitle: What to Keep in Mind When Coming to the Emergency Department
emergency.info1: Bring a list of your current medications.
emergency.info2: Bring your previous test results and reports.
emergency.info3: Have your ID card and SGK / private insurance details ready.
emergency.info4: It is recommended that you bring a companion.
emergency.warning1: Chest pain and shortness of breath
